summary: Iteration 11 (Credit Cards tab + 4 new CRUD endpoints) verified end-to-end. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_credit_cards.py — 19/19 tests pass (auth, CRUD happy-path with Create→GET persistence, PUT partial, empty-body→400, missing→404, validation (apr 0..100, statement_day 1..28, balance >=0, min_payment_percent 0..100, min_payment_floor >=0), user isolation). Regression suite: 130/134 pass; the 4 failing tests (test_calendar projection x2, test_datepicker_enddate active-flag, test_race_condition MONGO_URL) are pre-existing and documented in iteration_10 — unrelated to this iteration. Frontend: Cards tab visible between Insights and Goals (testID tab-cards). add-card-btn opens modal; name/balance/limit/apr/statement_day fields work and POST /api/credit-cards persists. Vertical stacked carousel confirmed — all collapsed cards are 72px tall at consecutive y-offsets (100,124,148,172) and tapping one expands it to 196px while others stay collapsed (verified via live bounding-rect measurement). Schedule modal opens, shows Minimum/Custom toggle, summary cells (Payments/Total paid/Interest), scrollable table (schedule-row-N testIDs rendered correctly), warning banner fires when custom payment ($1) doesn't cover monthly interest, and a very large custom payment ($99999 on $2500 balance) collapses the schedule to 1 payment with one month's interest ($47.90) as expected. No LogBox red overlay observed. KNOWN FRONTEND BUG DISCOVERED: nested testID props on the expanded card's action buttons (card-min-<id>, card-schedule-<id>, card-edit-<id>, card-delete-<id>) are NOT rendered as data-testid in react-native-web — only the outer TouchableOpacity's card-<id> testID is emitted. The buttons still function (clickable via visible text) but testID-based automation of per-card edit/schedule/delete is broken. Confirmed by DOM enumeration: only `card-<uuid>` appears, no nested suffixed testIDs. Likely cause: react-native-web collapses testID through nested Touchable components in some configurations. Additionally the card tap target in the stack is only ~24px of unobscured height per collapsed card, below the 44pt minimum touch-target guideline — tapping the visible top strip of one card can sometimes trigger a neighboring card due to z-order overlap.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested testID props on card action buttons are not emitted as data-testid in react-native-web. Only the outer TouchableOpacity's testID (`card-<id>`) is rendered. Breaks automation for per-card Schedule/Edit/Delete and MIN PAYMENT value readback. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/cards.tsx:306-332

Collapsed cards occupy only ~24px of unobstructed vertical space (height 72, marginBottom -48) which is far below the 44pt touch-target minimum. Due to DOM z-stacking (later siblings on top), tapping on what visually looks like one card's peek region can hit a different card. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/cards.tsx:275

issues: Collapsed card peek visible area (~24px) is below iOS 44pt / Android 48dp touch-target minimum.
Consider adding explicit zIndex per card based on expand state so the expanded card sits on top and taps on peek strips route reliably to the intended card.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web does not render testID on inner TouchableOpacity when the ancestor TouchableOpacity also has testID. Only the first testID in the chain survives. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/cards.tsx:311,320,326

action_items: Investigate why nested testIDs (card-min-<id>, card-schedule-<id>, card-edit-<id>, card-delete-<id>) do not propagate to data-testid in react-native-web. Options: (a) wrap each inner Touchable in a plain View with the testID applied there, or (b) move the testID onto the `<Text>` child that we currently rely on, or (c) use accessibilityLabel in addition so testing agents can target by text/accessibility name. Suggested quick fix: add a wrapping `<View testID="card-schedule-<id>">` around each inner TouchableOpacity.

Fix tap target reliability for the stacked carousel: give the EXPANDED card an explicit zIndex (e.g. zIndex=10) and give each collapsed card an incrementing zIndex so the visible peek strip always routes taps to the intended card. Also consider raising the per-card visible strip to >=44px (e.g. COLLAPSED_PEEK=96 with marginBottom=-48).
critical_code_review_comments: cards.tsx is 665 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; the schedule modal + buildSchedule could be extracted to /app/frontend/src/components/cards/ScheduleModal.tsx.
`load()` swallows all errors silently — any non-401 server error would leave the UI stuck on an empty list with no toast. Consider surfacing a small error state like other tabs do.
`openSchedule` default custom amount `Math.ceil(calcMinPayment(c) * 2)` is nice, but when balance is 0 it defaults to 0 and the Custom mode would then be unusable with a $0 default — minor edge case.
